oracle_first_order: Verify policy bindings and original environment/source identities.
Verify classifier_inputs.npz and its manifest before importing the isolated candidate.
Verify every classifier_timestep_XX.npz against classifier_oracle_manifest.json before importing the isolated candidate.
Run candidate primitive and classifier admission in a clean process with PYTHONPATH set only to the isolated snapshot.
Stop before component or full-pipeline execution on any categorical, identity, origin, or hash failure.

canonical_original_oracles.capture_state: captured and frozen before candidate comparison

stage_c_preflight_commands: .venv-light/bin/python -c "import hashlib,json,pathlib; p=json.load(open('reports/characterization/p8_portable_profile_v1/policy.json')); bad=[(f,h,hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()) for f,h in p['bindings'].items() if not pathlib.Path(f).is_file() or hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=h]; print(json.dumps(bad,indent=2)); raise SystemExit(bool(bad))"

.venv-light/bin/python -c "import hashlib,json,pathlib; d=pathlib.Path('reports/characterization/p8_portable_profile_v1/oracle'); m=json.load(open(d/'classifier_inputs_manifest.json')); assert hashlib.sha256((d/m['corpus']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==m['corpus_sha256']; o=json.load(open(d/'classifier_oracle_manifest.json')); assert o['input_corpus_sha256']==m['corpus_sha256']; assert all(hashlib.sha256((d/r['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256'] for r in o['timesteps']); print('verified',len(o['timesteps']),'timesteps')"

stage_c_candidate_command_contract.environment: fresh process; PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1; PYTHONPATH=<isolated_snapshot>/src; thread counts explicitly set; torch import forbidden
stage_c_candidate_command_contract.linux_required_matrix: identical to M1 plus retained 189220 Cura SVF corpus; use a newly authorized ledger-owned root, never the removed old root
stage_c_candidate_command_contract.runner_requirement: write a new output-parameterized runner under this experiment; it must consume the frozen manifests read-only and must not overwrite historical m1_full_solar outputs
stage_c_candidate_command_contract.stop_condition: any nonzero sun/shade mismatch, hash/origin mismatch, missing-value/infinity-mask mismatch, serial/prepared disagreement, or unsupported accepted input stops admission before full1024
